## PR Loop Checklist
- [ ] Read `docs/POINTER.md` before starting; addressed any open items in FIX-FIRST QUEUE.
- [ ] Pinned versions verified against `docs/VERSIONS.md`.
- [ ] Branch created from main: `<type>/<ID>-<slug>`.
- [ ] Design documented in ADR if touching schema, security, concurrency, or hot paths.
- [ ] Tests written first (happy, sad, edge, abuse paths).
- [ ] `pnpm run check` is 100% green.
- [ ] No tests weakened or skipped to pass.
- [ ] `docs/POINTER.md` updated with state, next up, and recent history.
- [ ] `docs/HANDBOOK.md` updated if new module or architectural flow added.
- [ ] `docs/ROADMAP.md` status updated.
- [ ] Conventional Commit message used.
